title: Recording a gateway payment now runs in a transaction that also holds the paid-invoice side effects

bugs.note: addPayment wraps the insert of the invoice transaction in DB::transaction. Creating that row fires observers that mark the invoice paid, run the paid-invoice service and send the invoice mail with a PDF written to disk, all inside the transaction. Any failure there (a full disk, a mail error) rolls back the payment row and the paid status: the gateway has the money, Paymenter has no record of it, the webhook answers 500 and every retry repeats the notifications.
